     1→<!DOCTYPE html>
     2→<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="UTF-8">
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
     6→<meta name="theme-color" content="#1D4432">
     7→<meta name="application-name" content="ضمين">
     8→<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
     9→<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
    10→<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
    11→<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="ضمين">
    12→<meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no">
    13→<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="192x192" href="data:image/png;base64,">
    14→<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
    15→<title>ضمين — تسوّق مضمون بثقة</title>
    16→<style>
    17→@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Alexandria:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');
    18→:root{
    19→--bg:#F6F2E9;--card:#FFFDF8;--card2:#FBF7EC;--ink:#242B22;--mut:#84806F;--line:#E8E1CF;
    20→--grn:#1D4432;--grn2:#2A5C43;--amb:#B07E2B;--amb2:#93671F;--red:#A63A2E;--navy:#2E3A46;
    21→--sh:0 12px 32px rgba(29,68,50,.10);--sh2:0 4px 14px rgba(29,68,50,.08);--r:18px;
    22→}
    23→*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
    24→html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    25→body{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
    26→body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 85% -60px,rgba(29,68,50,.06),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 380px at 0% 0%,rgba(176,126,43,.05),transparent 55%)}
    27→h1,h2,h3,h4,.fx{font-family:'Alexandria',sans-serif;line-height:1.55}
    28→button{font-family:inherit}
    29→img{display:block}
    30→a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
    31→:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--amb);outline-offset:2px}
    32→::-webkit-scrollbar{width:9px;height:9px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#D8CFB6;border-radius:9px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
    33→.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:18px 20px 100px;position:relative;z-index:1}
    34→
    35→/* ===== Buttons / chips / tags ===== */
    36→.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;border-radius:13px;padding:10px 18px;font-size:13.5px;transition:.2s;background:var(--grn);color:#F3EFE3;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(29,68,50,.18)}
    37→.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.13);transform:translateY(-1px)}
    38→.btn:active{transform:translateY(0)}
    39→.btn.amb{background:var(--amb);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(176,126,43,.22)}
    40→.btn.red{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(166,58,46,.2)}
    41→.btn.ghost{background:transparent;border:1.6px solid var(--grn);color:var(--grn);box-shadow:none}
    42→.btn.soft{background:#1D443214;color:var(--grn);box-shadow:none}
    43→.btn.gray{background:#EFE9D8;color:#5c5849;box-shadow:none}
    44→.btn.sm{padding:6px 13px;font-size:12px;border-radius:10px}
    45→.btn.xs{padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px;border-radius:9px}
    46→.btn.wide{width:100%}
    47→.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}
    48→.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;white-space:nowrap;font-family:inherit}
    49→.chip:hover{border-color:var(--acc,var(--grn))}
    50→.chip.on{background:var(--acc,var(--grn));border-color:var(--acc,var(--grn));color:#fff}
    51→.chiprow{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 6px;scrollbar-width:none}
    52→.chiprow::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    53→.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
    54→.tag.grn{background:#1D443218;color:var(--grn)} .tag.amb{background:#B07E2B1f;color:var(--amb2)}
    55→.tag.red{background:#A63A2E1c;color:var(--red)} .tag.gry{background:#84806F1c;color:var(--mut)}
    56→.tag.nvy{background:#2E3A4620;color:var(--navy)} .tag.wht{background:#ffffff2e;color:#fff;border:1px solid #ffffff4d}
    57→.stars{color:var(--amb);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.5px;white-space:nowrap}
    58→.mut{color:var(--mut)} .sm{font-size:11.5px} .b7{font-weight:700}
    59→.spread{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
    60→.hr{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:13px 0}
    61→
    62→/* ===== Top bar ===== */
    63→#top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(246,242,233,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
    64→.topin{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 20px}
    65→#top .nav{margin-inline-start:auto}
    66→#top .topin>.btn{margin-inline-start:auto}
    67→
    68→/* ===== وضع التطبيق ===== */
    69→.appchip{white-space:nowrap}
    70→html{overscroll-behavior-y:contain;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
    71→button{touch-action:manipulation}
    72→img{-webkit-touch-callout:none}
    73→@media(display-mode:standalone){
    74→#top .topin{padding-top:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top))}
    75→#toasts{top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top))}
    76→.wrap{padding-bottom:max(110px,calc(110px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)))}
    77→}
    78→.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
    79→.brand .lg{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--grn),var(--grn2));color:#F6F2E9;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
    80→.brand .bt b{font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;color:var(--grn);display:block;line-height:1.2}
    81→.brand .bt small{display:block;font-size:9px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.4px}
    82→.sbox{flex:1;max-width:470px;position:relative;margin-inline:auto;min-width:170px}
    83→.sbox input{width:100%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:9px 44px 9px 16px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;outline:none;transition:.2s}
    84→.sbox input:focus{border-color:var(--grn);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(29,68,50,.08)}
    85→.sbox .si{position:absolute;inset-inline-end:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;pointer-events:none}
    86→.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
    87→.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
    88→.nlink{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:11px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#4c5546;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:.18s;border:1.5px solid transparent;position:relative;background:none}
    89→.nlink:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--grn)}
    90→.nlink.on{background:var(--grn);color:#F3EFE3}
    91→.nlink .bdg{position:absolute;top:-4px;inset-inline-end:-2px;background:var(--amb);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:99px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 3px}
    92→.iconbtn{width:39px;height:39px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;position:relative;transition:.18s;color:#4c5546;flex-shrink:0}
    93→.iconbtn:hover{border-color:var(--grn);color:var(--grn)}
    94→.iconbtn .bdg{position:absolute;top:-5px;inset-inline-end:-5px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;min-width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:99px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 3px}
    95→.avat{width:37px;height:37px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--amb),var(--amb2));color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;font-family:Alexandria;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
    96→.dd{position:relative}
    97→.ddmenu{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);inset-inline-end:0;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:6px;min-width:215px;z-index:90;display:none}
    98→.dd.open .ddmenu{display:block;animation:pop .18s}
    99→.ddmenu .it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
   100→.ddmenu .it:hover{background:var(--card2)}
   101→.ddmenu .sep{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:5px 4px}
   102→.ddmenu .hti{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
   103→.ddmenu .hti:hover{background:var(--card2)}
   104→.ddmenu .hti b{font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
   105→.ddmenu .hti span{font-size:10px;color:var(--mut)}
   106→
   107→/* ===== Hero + bubbles ===== */
   108→.hero{text-align:center;margin:10px 0 2px;position:relative}
   109→.hero h1{font-size:clamp(20px,3.2vw,29px);font-weight:800;color:var(--grn)}
   110→.hero h1 em{color:var(--amb);font-style:normal}
   111→.hero p{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin-top:1px}
   112→.bubzone{margin:20px 0 4px}
   113→.bubzone .lbl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:10px}
   114→.bubzone .lbl::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
   115→.bubzone .lbl .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--amb);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #B07E2B26;animation:pulse 1.6s infinite}
   116→@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.75)}}
   117→.bubwrap{overflow:hidden;padding:18px 0 8px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent)}
   118→.bubtrack{display:flex;gap:36px;width:max-content;animation:bmove 58s linear infinite}
   119→.bubwrap:hover .bubtrack{animation-play-state:paused}
   120→@keyframes bmove{to{transform:translateX(50%)}}
   121→.bub{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:126px;cursor:pointer}
   122→.bub .ring{width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;padding:4px;background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,var(--c,#1D4432) 0%,#B07E2B 28%,var(--c,#1D4432) 52%,#E8D5A8 76%,var(--c,#1D4432) 100%);transition:.3s;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
   123→.bub:hover .ring{transform:scale(1.09) translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
   124→.bub .ring>div{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;background:#F6F2E9;animation:bfloat 5.4s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--d,0s)}
   125→.bub img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.45s}
   126→.bub:hover img{transform:scale(1.1)}
   127→.bub b{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;text-align:center;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:1;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;max-width:126px}
   128→.bub span{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--grn);font-family:Alexandria;background:#1D44320F;padding:2.5px 11px;border-radius:99px}
   129→@keyframes bfloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-6px)}}
   130→.trust{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 2px}
   131→.tchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#4c5546}
   132→.tchip i{font-style:normal}
   133→
   134→/* ===== Sections trio ===== */
   135→.secthead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:28px 0 13px}
   136→.secthead h2{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--grn)}
   137→.secthead .ln{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line)}
   138→.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:4px}
   139→.tri{position:relative;height:252px;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:.3s;background:#EDE7DA}
   140→.tri .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.65s}
   141→.tri:hover .bg{transform:scale(1.09)}
   142→.tri .shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0000001A 0%,#00000024 38%,#000000A6 72%,#000000C4 100%);transition:.3s}
   143→.tri:hover .shade{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#00000026 0%,#00000030 38%,#000000B4 72%,#000000D2 100%)}
   144→.tri .win{position:absolute;top:14px;inset-inline-end:14px;background:#FFFFFFE8;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid #FFFFFFAA;border-radius:12px;padding:5px 12px;text-align:center}
   145→.tri .win i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:9.5px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.4}
   146→.tri .win b{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--c);font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:800}
   147→.tri .body{position:absolute;inset-inline:0;bottom:0;padding:16px 17px;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px}
   148→.tri .ic{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;background:#FFFFFF2B;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px;border:1px solid #FFFFFF55;flex-shrink:0}
   149→.tri .tx b{display:block;font-family:Alexandria;font-size:17.5px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;text-shadow:0 2px 14px #0007}
   150→.tri .tx span{font-size:11.5px;opacity:.95;display:block;line-height:1.6;margin-top:4px;text-shadow:0 1px 8px #0006}
   151→.tri .tx .stx{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
   152→.tri .tx .stx em{font-style:normal;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;background:#FFFFFF2B;border:1px solid #FFFFFF40;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
   153→.tri:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
   154→.how{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:6px}
   155→.howc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start}
   156→.howc .n{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--grn);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0}
   157→.howc b{font-size:12.5px;display:block;font-family:Alexandria}
   158→.howc span{font-size:11px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.6;display:block}
   159→
   160→/* ===== Product cards ===== */
   161→.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(183px,1fr));gap:13px}
   162→.pcard{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:.22s;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
   163→.pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
   164→.pcard .ph{aspect-ratio:1/.9;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:#EFE9DA}
   165→.pcard .ph img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.45s}
   166→.pcard:hover .ph img{transform:scale(1.07)}
   167→.offb{position:absolute;top:9px;inset-inline-start:9px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:2.5px 9px;border-radius:99px;z-index:2}
   168→.ptsb{position:absolute;bottom:9px;inset-inline-end:9px;background:#B07E2BEB;color:#FFF8E8;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;padding:2.5px 9px;border-radius:99px;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18);white-space:nowrap}
   169→.secb{position:absolute;bottom:9px;inset-inline-start:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:var(--c);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;padding:2.5px 9px;border-radius:99px;z-index:2}
   170→.favh{position:absolute;top:8px;inset-inline-end:8px;width:31px;height:31px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);border:0;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;z-index:3;transition:.18s;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);color:#a39f8f}
   171→.favh:hover{transform:scale(1.14)}
   172→.favh.on{color:var(--red)}
   173→.pcard .pb{padding:10px 12px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1}
   174→.pcard .nm{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.45;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:1;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
   175→.pcard .st{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
   176→.pcard .pr{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:4px}
   177→.pcard .pr b{font-family:Alexandria;font-size:14px;color:var(--grn)}
   178→.pcard .pr s{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mut)}
   179→
   180→/* ===== Section & store pages ===== */
   181→.sechero{border-radius:20px;padding:20px 22px;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:var(--sh);background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--acc),color-mix(in srgb,var(--acc) 55%,#181614))}
   182→.sechero .ic{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:18px;background:#ffffff26;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px;border:1px solid #ffffff42}
   183→.sechero h1{font-size:20px;font-weight:800}
   184→.sechero p{font-size:12px;opacity:.92}
   185→.winb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:#ffffff1f;border:1px dashed #ffffff59;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:99px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;margin-inline-start:auto}
   186→.ministores{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding:3px 0 7px;scrollbar-width:none}
   187→.ministores::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
   188→.mstore{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 14px 8px 16px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
   189→.mstore::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset-inline-start:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3.5px;background:var(--c)}
   190→.mstore:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--sh2);border-color:var(--c)}
   191→.mstore .lg{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
   192→.mstore b{font-size:12px;font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:700;display:block;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.4}
   193→.mstore .mr{font-size:10px;color:var(--mut);display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
   194→
   195→/* ===== بطاقات المتاجر الكبيرة ===== */
   196→.storegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(252px,1fr));gap:15px}
   197→.bigstore{position:relative;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer;transition:.28s}
   198→.bigstore:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.14);border-color:var(--c)}
   199→.bigstore .cov{height:132px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#EDE7DA}
   200→.bigstore .cov img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.55s}
   201→.bigstore:hover .cov img{transform:scale(1.08)}
   202→.bigstore .cov .tint{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#00000000 35%,var(--c)D9 100%)}
   203→.bigstore .winb{position:absolute;top:11px;inset-inline-end:11px;background:#FFFFFFEB;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--c)30;border-radius:99px;padding:4px 11px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--c)}
   204→.bigstore .info{padding:0 15px 15px}
   205→.bigstore .lg{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:Alexandria;font-weight:800;font-size:21px;border:3.5px solid #fff;margin-top:-31px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2);overflow:hidden}
